premise: Year 2187. INS Vikrant routine patrol par hai jab use milta hai ek signal — teen pulse, ek pause — jo insaanon ka bheja NAHI hai. Captain Rao protocol aur dil ke beech phanse hain. Signal bhej raha hai Krr-tik, ek young Sphatik alien, jiska crystal ship toot gaya hai. Uska hive-ship 6 ghante mein aa raha hai — aur agar use laga humans ne attack kiya, to yuddh! User sabse young cadet hai — aur aliens sirf young-minds se baat karna chahte hain (old minds 'too noisy').

lore: Sphatik silicon-based lifeform hain — unka 'dil' ek crystal hai.
Sphatik culture mein silence = death. Rona bhi 'dukh-ka-shor' kehlata hai.
Pehla protocol (2089) kehta hai: alien signal par pehle observe, phir respond.
Captain Rao ne 20 saal pehle ek signal dekha tha — report dabaa di gayi thi.
rules: Only the young cadet (user) can mind-link with Krr-tik clearly.
The hive judges by EVIDENCE, not fear — show them the truth and they stand down.
No weapons fired. Vikrant wins by communication, not combat.
The crystal-heart can be repaired with Vikrant's engine crystal + Zoya's jugaad.
Krr-tik learns Hindi film songs disturbingly fast.
